message.content:
The cost of renting an apartment in New York varies widely depending on the borough, neighborhood, and size of the unit. On average:

| Borough | Typical monthly rent (1‑bedroom) |
|---------|---------------------------------|
| Manhattan | **$3,500–$4,500** |
| Brooklyn | **$2,800–$3,800** |
| Queens | **$2,200–$3,200** |
| Bronx | **$1,800–$2,600** |
| Staten Island | **$1,700–$2,400** |

These figures reflect current market averages (late 2025). Prices can be higher in upscale neighborhoods or lower in more affordable areas. If you’re looking at larger units or luxury apartments, rents can exceed these ranges significantly.
